one_liner: Smartsheet is a cloud work-management platform for tracking projects, collaborating in sheets, and automating workflows, with a broad REST API, an official MCP server, and a Composio toolkit.

auth.notes: Smartsheet recommends OAuth 2.0 for integrations that involve user consent. Unattended integrations can use a user-generated access token as an HTTP Bearer credential.

access.notes: API token generation is self-service on Business, Enterprise, and Advanced Work Management plans. OAuth app registration requires an existing licensed Business-or-higher user. It is not verified whether the public trial includes API credentials or whether a free developer sandbox is available.

api.notes: Public developer guides document read and write operations for core resources such as sheets, rows, and reports, with additional coverage for folders, users, and webhooks.

mcp.notes: Smartsheet hosts production endpoints in the US, EU, and Australia. The server provides read and write tools and supports a Smartsheet API token or OAuth in supported clients.

verdict.rationale: The documented read/write REST API is broad enough to build a useful integration on a qualifying plan. It remains unverified whether a new developer can obtain working credentials through the public trial or a free sandbox.

“Manage the entire lifecycle of a report with the new endpoints .”

“With dozens of tools available at GA — spanning discovery, data retrieval, sheet creation, row and column operations, and collaboration — the MCP Server covers the workflows developers need from day one.”

“Smartsheet is a collaborative work management platform for organizing projects, sheets, reports, dashboards, workflows, and teams.”

problems: The public trial signup does not state whether API token generation is included. No trial credentials were generated or tested.
The OpenAPI reference root and Sheets reference did not load in the research tools. The public developer guides were readable and supplied the API evidence above.
